description:
Use this when the user wants the latest result of a named ready-made screen from list_preset_screens.

Returns the stored result of one ready-made screen, computed nightly: up to 50 rows, the filters it applied and the number of matches. `name` is one of the names from list_preset_screens. For more rows or other thresholds, pass the returned `filters` to screen_stocks.
name: run_preset_screen
title: Run a preset screen
